description: American Express is a global payments and premium lifestyle brand powered by technology. Founded in 1850 and headquartered in New York, its card-issuing, merchant-acquiring and card network businesses offer products and services to a broad range of customers, including consumers, small businesses, mid-sized companies and large corporations around the world. Its products and services include credit and charge cards and complementary travel, dining, lifestyle and expense management offerings, banking and other payment and financing products including deposits and non-card lending, merchant acquisition and processing, and network services, offered through channels such as mobile and online applications, affiliate marketing, third-party service providers and business partners. Worldwide processed volume was $227.2 billion for 2025 and it had 66.2 million cards-in-force issued by third parties.
